definitions: It is pointless to argue with an irrational person because they will not understand logic or reason.
Engaging in a debate or argument with someone who is incapable of rational thought or unwilling to listen to reason is a futile exercise.
examples: Trying to explain the new policy to him is like you may as well play chess with a pigeon; he just won't get it.
When it comes to discussing politics with my uncle, you may as well play chess with a pigeon, he's so set in his ways.
I tried to reason with the customer, but it was like you may as well play chess with a pigeon; they just kept yelling.
source: you may as well play chess with a pigeon.
